ausopen.has_time: raw match centre has a time per point (not kept in the shot-level table)

ausopen_mc.has_time: kept: t_utc, the match centre's time of each point (whole seconds)

slamtracker.has_time: raw feed has a clock time per point (not kept in the shot-level table)

tdi.has_time: raw feed has a UTC time per point (not kept in the shot-level table)

wta.has_time: kept: t_utc, the umpire log's millisecond UTC time of each point

wta_pbp.has_time: kept: t_utc, the point-by-point feed's UTC time (whole seconds)

wta_feeds.agree_means: both winners and servers equal on at least 98% of the points the two hold in common (at least 20)

strict_means: usable, and where Stage 0 has a box score, each player's serve points counted from the sequence equal the box score's (a box score with the players' serve statistics the other way round is accepted when another source agrees with the sequence)

tiers.0: complete, official score reproduced (or none to check, under the first-candidate rule), not contradicted by another source
tiers.1: as 0, but every other source holding the match disagrees with it point by point
tiers.2: partial: the match ended early (retirement, default) and the replay reproduces the official score
tiers.3: partial: a truncated record, its sets the beginning of the official score
tiers.4: complete, but the official score differs (or a fallback rule could not be checked against it)
tiers.5: partial, not matching the official score
tiers.6: inconsistent: points after the end, an unknown point winner, game/set labels that break the rules, or (SofaScore, marcosjn2) a regular game whose own server field breaks the alternation

defective_reused_tables.ausopen: every game's last point is missing (rows of type game/set/match left out); replaced by ausopen_mc
